submission_id.description: New UUID for each user intent. Reuse the same value only when resending the identical request; a different intent always gets a new submission_id.
submission_id.title: Submission Id

event_id.description: DoneWise event id from an earlier receipt, always evt_... (not a Google id). Give exactly one of event_id or event_query.
event_id.title: Event Id

event_query.description: Words from the event title to locate it, for example Plumber, when the event_id is unknown. Give exactly one of event_id or event_query.
event_query.title: Event Query

new_start.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit UTC offset in the user's timezone, for example 2026-09-19T10:00:00-07:00. Must be later than the current time and within the next twelve months; never a bare date or a naive time.
new_start.title: New Start

new_end.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an explicit UTC offset; must be later than the start.
new_end.title: New End

timezone.description: IANA timezone the user is scheduling in, for example America/Los_Angeles.
timezone.title: Timezone

retry_of_operation_id.description: Only when the user explicitly asks to retry an operation whose receipt was NOT_OBSERVED: the operation_id from that receipt. Never set it on your own initiative.
retry_of_operation_id.title: Retry Of Operation Id
